Noah (Finance): Quick mid-quarter procurement check-in for teams: please run a light review of any planned vendor spend > $4k this sprint. Were seeing clusters of small buys that collectively push some cost centers over forecast. If your work impacts Q2 budget, tag the ticket with "budget-impact" and add an estimated hit to the cost_center field.

Aisha (Product): Can you clarify: if we have multiple related line items that total > $4k but each is < $4k, does that count?

Noah (Finance): Yes  if line items are clearly part of the same vendor engagement or same initiative, treat as a combined commitment and include in the ticket summary as a single commitment. Splitting to avoid review will be consolidated. :warning:

Carlos (Eng): We have a set of tooling subscriptions across repos that could total ~6k/year. What's the quickest path to get them in the SaaS inventory?

Sasha (Accounting): File a procurement ticket with vendor name, estimate, and account owner. Use the PO template if paying annually. We'll run a 48-hour intake for SaaS additions flagged "budget-impact". Also attach billing cadence so we know if it's monthly vs annual.

procure-bot: procurement ticket created: FIN-2026-5560 by Carlos (Eng)  status: intake queued.

Aisha (Product): Are there office hours to walk through approvals?

Noah (Finance): Yes  standing finance office hours Tuesdays 11-12 PT for quick intake questions and same-week triage. If you need a one-off consult outside that window, DM finance or add "expedite" to the ticket with PM sign-off.

Carlos (Eng): Thanks  added the SaaS items and tagged "budget-impact".

Sasha (Accounting): Reminder: PCard single txn cap remains $5k. For annual prepayments >$2k use a PO and include GL & project_code. Missing fields slow AP.

Noah (Finance): TL;DR: tag tickets that change Q2 spend with "budget-impact", combine related vendor line items into one commit, use Tuesday office hours for quick help, attach billing cadence + GL. We'll publish a short daily digest of flagged tickets for the next two weeks.
